item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"status\",\"--short\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--check\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate\\n\\ncases=[\\n ({'declared':['b','a','a','skip'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'x','meta':1},'b':{'kind':'missing'},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'extra':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{'a':{'meta':2,'hash':'x','kind':'file'},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'extra':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'}}},{'ignored':['skip']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'z'}},'current':{}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']}),\\n]\\nfor r,p,want in cases:\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(r),copy.deepcopy(p); got=evaluate(r,p); assert got==want,(got,want); assert r==rb and p==pb\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); assert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"list\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\".\"}}]}"}
